reason: An agent-oriented Godot integration that automates running, inspecting, debugging, interacting with, modifying, validating, and exporting Godot 4.x projects through native tools.

summaries.zh: 通过原生工具自动运行、检查、调试、交互、修改、验证和导出 Godot 4.x 项目。
summaries.en: Provides native agent tools to run, inspect, debug, interact with, modify, validate, and export Godot 4.x projects.

capabilities: Reads incremental Godot stdout and stderr output
Sends commands to a running Godot game over localhost TCP
Evaluates code and performs game interactions such as clicks and key presses
Captures screenshots as base64 PNG data
Modifies Godot project settings, autoloads, input maps, export presets, scenes, and resources
Validates GDScript and exports Godot projects
Performs a best-effort version check against a remote GitHub raw file
